integrity: The all-size claim is proved by exact Fourier diagonalization and ordered folded-angle gaps, and corroborated by 10064 reproducible finite checks. Earlier work contains the energy formula, the odd resonant phase, and simple-spectrum average uniformity; these are not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Only Hermitian uniform-hopping cyclic quantum walks, minimum indexed eigenenergy spacing; does not claim optimal transport/mixing time or robustness. Older flux-ring literature remains a possible source of equivalent results.
title: Parity-sharp flux optimization of spectral separation in chiral quantum cycles
